signal-mint-deep.purpose: Primary action gradient start (135deg to scanner-cyan-deep); flat press-end stand-in.

scanner-cyan-deep.purpose: Primary action gradient end; the cyan family's deep register.

code-jade.purpose: Inline code literal pills — deep jade end of the optic family.

ambient-violet.purpose: Violet corner of the fixed background mesh glow — page light-work only, never a UI accent.

display.purpose: Page h1, verdict banner frame, KPI numerals (30px variant).

title.purpose: Card h2 and the nav brand line.

body.purpose: All UI prose; leads capped near 66ch.

label.purpose: KPI labels, table headers — tracked uppercase micro-labels.

mono.purpose: Machine channels only: module codes, HUD lines, status chips, phase labels, stamps' meta.

shadows.name: ambient-seat
shadows.purpose: Default seat under card shells and KPI tiles.

shadows.name: pop-lift
shadows.purpose: Foreground chrome only — toasts and the nav island.

shadows.name: press-pool
shadows.purpose: Primary button's own colored pool; pairs with inset lip rgba(255,255,255,0.28).

shadows.name: live-ring
shadows.purpose: The ring token — sensor-live and focus moments only (Live-Earns-Color Rule).

shadows.name: verdict-seat
shadows.purpose: ACCEPT banner; ember variant rgba(217,45,32,0.45) for REJECT.

shadows.name: inset-lip
shadows.purpose: Inner core lip of the double bezel — depth without light.

motion.name: ease-io
motion.purpose: Continuous sweeps (scan band) and toast exits.

motion.name: panel-in
motion.purpose: State-change entrances: wizard steps (400ms), verdict card + eval results (300ms).

motion.name: row-in
motion.purpose: Console rows and score rows appearing in sequence.

motion.name: stamp-in
motion.purpose: The ACCESS GRANTED/DENIED stamp — the system's single authored loudest moment.

motion.name: toast-in-out
motion.purpose: Symmetric toast path: bottom-right enters, bottom-right leaves.

motion.name: scroll-reveal
motion.purpose: First-paint choreography via motion.js IntersectionObserver; JS-applied so failure never hides content.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill CTA with mint-to-cyan gradient, inset lip, and a nested trailing icon orb.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0b9370 0%, #0c7f9c 100%); color: #ffffff; font: 600 13.5px "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(11, 147, 112, 0.55), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28); transition: transform 380ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)), filter 380ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--optic-bright, #0e8f7c); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; transform: none; box-shadow: none; cursor: default; } .ds-orb { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; margin-right: -8px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); font-size: 13px; transition: transform 380ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-orb { transform: translate(3px, -2px) scale(1.06); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline-glass pill for secondary actions and table row commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.09)); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #14181d); font: 600 12.5px "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 320ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)), border-color 320ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.04); border-color: var(--hairline-strong, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.16)); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--optic-bright, #0e8f7c); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pill Input
components.description: White pill field with the deep-mint focus halo.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: var(--input-max, 460px); padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.16)); border-radius: 999px; font: 400 14px "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #14181d); background: #ffffff; transition: border-color 300ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)), box-shadow 300ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)), background 300ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(100, 112, 125, 0.65); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.55); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.13); background: #ffffff; }

components.name: Console Card
components.description: The double-bezel signature: pale shell around a concentric porcelain core with an inset lip.
components.html:
Auth request

Glass shell, machined core. Inner radius equals outer radius minus bezel inset, always concentric.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; padding: 18px 22px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.09)); border-radius: 30px; background: linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.66)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.05), 0 18px 44px -24px rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.22); max-width: 560px; } .ds-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 18px 22px 20px; z-index: -1; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #fcfdfc 100%); border-radius: calc(30px - 20px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.05); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 600 15.5px "Space Grotesk", "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--ink, #14181d); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font: 400 14px/1.65 "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-soft, #333b44); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Console-voice status pill; the live state earns the blinking dot and deep-mint glow.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.09)); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.035); color: var(--ink-muted, #64707d); font: 500 10px "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: color 300ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)), border-color 300ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)), background 300ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)); } .ds-chip::before { content: ""; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-chip-live { color: var(--optic-deep, #0b7565); border-color: rgba(12, 151, 106, 0.35); background: rgba(12, 151, 106, 0.08); box-shadow: 0 0 18px -6px rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.4); } .ds-chip-live::before { opacity: 1; animation: ds-chip-blink 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-chip-blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.25; } }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Porcelain pill notice; enters and leaves bottom-right via the same edge.
components.css: .ds-toast { box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 340px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.09)); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92); color: var(--ink, #14181d); font: 500 13px "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 24px 70px -28px rgba(20, 24, 29, 0.35); animation: ds-toast-in 480ms var(--ease-standard, cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)); transition: opacity 240ms var(--ease-io, cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 0.2, 1)), transform 240ms var(--ease-io, cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 0.2, 1)); } .ds-toast.ds-toast-good { border-color: rgba(12, 151, 106, 0.4); } .ds-toast.ds-toast-bad { border-color: rgba(217, 45, 32, 0.4); } .ds-toast.ds-toast-out { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px) scale(0.97); } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.96); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

components.name: Verdict Banner
components.description: The decision surface — accept and reject states with their earned seat.
components.html:
ACCESS GRANTED

ACCESS DENIED
components.css: .ds-verdict { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font: 650 clamp(19px, 2.4vw, 23px) "Space Grotesk", "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 22px; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-verdict-accept { background: var(--signal-mint-wash, rgba(12, 151, 106, 0.10)); color: #067a52; border: 1px solid rgba(12, 151, 106, 0.32); box-shadow: 0 12px 34px -18px rgba(12, 151, 106, 0.5); } .ds-verdict-reject { background: var(--danger-wash, rgba(217, 45, 32, 0.09)); color: var(--danger-ember, #d92d20); border: 1px solid rgba(217, 45, 32, 0.32); box-shadow: 0 12px 34px -18px rgba(217, 45, 32, 0.45); }

narrative.overview: ARGUS renders the hundred-eyed watchman at his instrument. This revision moves that instrument into daylight: warm paper (#f4f5f2) instead of a void, deep graphite ink instead of glowing white, and porcelain panels — white cores seated inside a pale shell — instead of black glass in the dark. The console is an Operate surface, so craft concentrates in precision furniture: hairline joints, machined radii, tabular numerals, a dedicated console voice for machine channels. The rare theatrical moment — the verification pipeline with its scan sweep, staged module rows and verdict stamp — survives the re-skin; it is a committed product ritual, not decoration; the numbers it displays are always the live pipeline's actual output. Theatrical motion is spent exactly and only there.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight surface: faint emerald/violet/cyan mesh (10–13% alpha) on warm paper, self-hosted grain at 2.8% opacity.

Porcelain panels in honest depth — 1px ink hairlines mark joints; soft ambient shadows lift cards off the paper; blur is reserved to fixed chrome (nav pill, toasts) where it frosts a moving scene behind it.
Optic accents (Signal Mint #0da271 accept, Scanner Cyan #0e7490 live optics) are earned by state — never decoration.
Machine channels speak the console voice — JetBrains Mono 10–10.5px tracked caps.
Double-bezel machining survives the re-skin: every card is a pale shell around an inset porcelain core, radii strictly concentric.
Camera has an on-switch: the Face step auto-starts the sensor and always shows an explicit Enable camera control plus a live/blocked state chip.

Typing is phased and forgiving: the rhythm step names the phase (A · dwell, B · flight, C · correction) in the HUD line, and a typo corrected with backspace no longer voids the round — the correction stays inside the sample as behavior.

rules.name: The Live-Earns-Color Rule
rules.body: Colored shadows, rings and tints attach only to live or decision states — running sensor chips, focus, the verdict, the phase chip. At rest, cards stay seated on ambient shadow alone.

rules.name: The Numeral-Only Gradient Rule
rules.body: A brand gradient may paint type in exactly one place — dashboard KPI numerals (background-clip: text). Prose and headings never wear it.

rules.name: The Multiply-Not-Screen Rule
rules.body: The scan band over the camera feed blends multiply (a bright band would erase the feed under screen). A screen-blended light effect only ever belongs on a dark surface.

rules.name: The Console Column Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono belongs to machine channels — codes, measurements, machine state. Body prose never borrows mono as a technicality costume.

rules.name: The Porcelain Rule
rules.body: Blur belongs to fixed chrome (nav, toasts) where it frosts a live scene behind it; scrolling content never carries backdrop-filter. Depth is shadow + hairline + inset lip — never a darker, offset "drop shadow" costume, and never a hard black shadow on paper.

rules.name: The Double-Bezel Rule
rules.body: Machining is concentric or it is wrong: inner radius = outer radius − bezel inset. A card's core never out-corners its shell.

dos: Do animate transform, opacity and bounded filter only; use --ease cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) for UI, --ease-io for sweeps.
Do keep borders rgba(20,24,29,0.09) hairlines and data numerals tabular-nums.
Do self-host every asset — the CSP is default-src 'self' with no inline style/script; page config rides the #bio-config JSON block.
Do stagger sibling entrances 90–450ms via data-delay steps through the motion.js observer; state entrances land 240–400ms.
Do treat reduced-motion as global: the stylesheet collapses all animation/transition to 0.01ms and neutralizes reveals.
Do give every sensor a visible on-switch and a state chip — the camera says camera on / camera off, the phase says which trait it is measuring.
donts: Don't put a colored shadow or ring on anything that isn't live, focus, or a verdict (The Live-Earns-Color Rule).
Don't use backdrop-blur on scrolling content; fixed chrome only.
Don't animate width/height/top/left — bars fill with scaleX, strips with scaleY.
Don't introduce a third accent or paint free-floating gradients on gaps; mint and cyan are state-earned, ≤ ~10% of any screen combined.
Don't use mix-blend-mode: screen on a light surface (The Multiply-Not-Screen Rule).
Don't hard-code raster font links, inline styles, or inline scripts; mono is for console voice, never for prose.
